prompts.text: What's the most interesting thing you've noticed while waiting for a journey to begin?
The unplanned stop on a trip sometimes deserves more attention than the destination.
Our train is delayed for an hour in a town neither of us knows. What would you want to do nearby?
A window seat with a view of the countryside or an aisle seat where you have more room?
Tell me about a journey where you met someone whose story surprised you.
The objects people pack for a short trip often reveal their priorities better than their luggage size.
Is there a journey you remember mainly for the conversations you had along the way?
Getting lost for a few minutes is more enjoyable when nobody feels responsible for knowing every turn.
We're visiting a new city and have one free evening. How would you choose between exploring and resting?
A ferry ride with fresh air or a scenic railway trip where you watch the landscape change?
